title: Paper Collage
style: Cut-paper collage on kraft paper: shapes with torn, slightly irregular edges, a paper-grain texture, drop shadows as if lifted off the page, halftone patches, two hands cut from paper that slide a puzzle piece into place, a retro computer made of paper shapes. Everything moves like stop motion (hold each pose 2 frames). Captions are serif word ladders (kit captions.ts): short stacks of mixed sizes, one key word in the accent italic, set beside the action and arriving word by word.
learnsFrom: Founder explainer reels (Instagram, @gregisenberg's team): editorial collage: cut-out hands, a puzzle piece that completes the picture, a retro computer beside a circle, textured paper.

story.what: hook: a torn-paper headline 'The missing piece' is pasted on, letter scraps sliding into place
a paper calendar with one torn-out hole; paper hands enter carrying the missing piece
a retro paper computer beside a big circle; on its screen, paper scraps rearrange into 'Thu 3:00'
three paper portraits (simple shapes) each get a paper check mark pasted on
the hands press the puzzle piece into the calendar; it clicks, the grain shifts, confetti scraps burst
sign-off: 'Oriel' in cut letters; caption 'the piece your week was missing'

sizes: Landscape spreads the collage across the page, calendar left, computer right.
sound: beatScore soft at 120 bpm with paper rustles (short noise) on each paste, a hit when the piece clicks in and the sign-off.
teaches: Collage is texture plus timing: irregular edges, grain and shadows sell the paper, and holding each pose for two frames sells stop motion.
